# Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta10

## Stable four-button styling
- Keep all four controls visible without layout movement.
- **Mow** and **Resume** always retain their blue backgrounds; **Pause** and **Dock/Home** always retain their light-gray backgrounds.
- Enabled blue buttons use white labels/icons. Enabled gray buttons use light-blue (#38bdf8) labels/icons.
- Disabled buttons remain fully opaque, with dark-gray (#374151) labels/icons, regardless of background; do not apply disabled background or a global opacity fade.
- Keep the native-style cancellation confirmation and selected-zone Mow during Returning introduced in beta9.

## QA
- Added regression coverage for single and Multi Mower CSS selectors and foreground/background contrast semantics.
- No change to mower protocol or commands. Pair with integration 0.5.0-beta35.
